all_playlists=[]
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, query='', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='-created_at')
    if not resp:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1
    if page_index>1000:
        break

print('playlists_total', len(all_playlists))

removed_from_playlists=[]
for p in all_playlists:
    pid=p['playlist_id']
    title=p['title']
    pl=apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=access_token)
    songs=pl.get('songs',[])
    remove_song_ids=[]
    for s in songs:
        sid=s.get('id')
        if sid is None:
            continue
        song_det=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
        rd=song_det.get('release_date')
        if not rd:
            continue
        year=int(str(rd)[:4])
        if year>2021:
            remove_song_ids.append((sid, s.get('title'), year, rd))
    # Verification print
    print('playlist', pid, title, 'songs', len(songs), 'remove_candidates', len(remove_song_ids))
    if remove_song_ids:
        for item in sorted(remove_song_ids, key=lambda x:x[2], reverse=True):
            print('  candidate', item)
    # Perform removals
    for sid, stitle, year, rd in remove_song_ids:
        resp=apis.spotify.remove_song_from_playlist(playlist_id=pid, song_id=sid, access_token=access_token)
        removed_from_playlists.append({'playlist_id':pid,'song_id':sid,'title':stitle,'release_year':year,'release_date':rd})
        print('  removed', sid, stitle, 'resp', resp)

print('total_removed_from_playlists', len(removed_from_playlists))
print('removed_list', removed_from_playlists)
